line.missing_policy: Coerce y numerically; drop only blank/NA y rows; never impute.
line.sort_policy: Retain CSV row order and line connection order.

groupedbar.missing_policy: No missing measurements; do not aggregate.
groupedbar.sort_policy: A/B/C left to right; control then treatment within each category. Input and container order may vary.

scatter.missing_policy: Drop blank y only; retain every other row including s1199; distractor is not a measurement.
scatter.sort_policy: Unordered scatter; match rows by unique x, never sample or truncate.

custom2panel.sort_policy: Left line retains CSV row order; right scatter is unordered. Left/right panel position is semantic.
